newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco and Cape Verde sign cooperation deals.
newsitem.headline: Morocco and Cape Verde sign cooperation deals.

text.p: Morocco and Cape Verde signed trade, fishing and diplomatic cooperation accords and pledged to strengthen their relations, the two countries' prime ministers said on Wednesday in a joint statement.

"The two sides reasserted their firm willingness to boost the cooperation between the two countries to a level worthy of their assets, economic potential and people's expectations," the statement said.

Cape Verde Prime Minister Carlos Veiga on Wednesday ended a three-day official visit to Morocco during which he met his counterpart Abdellatif Filali and senior officials to discuss coopertion. He was also received by King Hassan.
